facts.text: Jolene participated in a mini retreat on Wednesday, which she described as a positive experience that provided a new outlook on her life.

evidence.quote: Last Wednesday I did a mini retreat to assess where I'm at in life. It was a dope experience that totally gave me a new outlook.

facts.text: Jolene reported that the retreat resulted in significant personal achievements and a confidence boost.

evidence.quote: I achieved so much more than I imagined. It was a real confidence boost.

facts.text: Jolene mentioned that she developed some neat solutions for her engineering project during the retreat.

evidence.quote: I really accomplished something with my engineering project - I came up with some neat solutions and I'm really excited about it.
